headline: Who should attend
intro: PharmaDS is where the people building the data-driven, AI-enabled future of pharma come together — to learn, to show their work, and to grow their network and careers.

personas.title: Statisticians & Data Scientists
personas.value: Sharpen modern design, causal, and ML methods and see how peers put them into production.

personas.title: AI / ML Engineers
personas.value: Crash-course the engineering behind models that ship — pipelines, tooling, and deployment in a regulated world.

personas.title: RWE & Clinical Researchers
personas.value: Translate real-world and trial data into credible evidence with the latest analytics.

personas.title: Regulatory & Safety
personas.value: Track where AI-driven pharmacovigilance and evidence standards are heading, straight from peers and agencies.

personas.title: Leaders & Decision-Makers
personas.value: Get a candid 360° view of where the biggest wins are, where barriers remain, and where to invest next.

personas.title: Early-Career & Academic Talent
personas.value: Find mentors, real projects, and a community — our career-growth program is built for you.

gains: Actionable techniques you can apply on Monday morning
A community that continues long after the conference
Direct access to mentors, collaborators, and hiring teams
